values.note: City of Salem's posted rates, one price for everyone (the city's resident/non-resident split is for parking stickers, not camping): waterview RV sites 1-5 (25 ft max), 10 and 10A $50; RV Field sites 42-53 $55; waterfront sites 16-16D $55 and 12-15 $60. An extra vehicle is $5 a night. ReserveAmerica adds $3.50 per reservation; a cancellation 7+ days out costs $15, and none is refunded inside 7 days.

note: City of Salem park on Winter Island at the mouth of Salem Harbor, minutes from downtown (2 miles to the Salem commuter-rail station, 1.2 miles to the Boston ferry). Fort Pickering and its lighthouse, beaches and a boat ramp. The waterfront RV sites (12-15, 16-16D) line the harbor edge by South Beach and the boat ramp; the RV Field is inland. No ground fires (bring a raised fire pit) and no firewood sold. Park gate locks overnight; campers get the gate code at check-in. --Claude
